versions.changelog: Relicense to Apache-2.0 (matches each skill's own frontmatter); publish previously-unlisted skills (document-finder, legal-page-discovery, part-2-notice-assessment, skill-router)

- Skill card file (skill-card.md) has been removed.
- Version metadata and license fields have been dropped from SKILL.md.
- Description updated to emphasize remediation recommendations.
- Output format clarified: produce a single structured JSON compliance report for the entire BAA, including party identification, summary, and findings on all 9 required provisions.
- Methodological instructions streamlined and detailed under “Instructions” and “Analysis Procedure”.
- The rest of methodology, provision checklist, rubric, and few-shot examples preserved.

Initial release: Clause-by-clause BAA analysis against all 9 required HIPAA contractual provisions per 45 CFR 164.504(e)(2), with risk scoring and remediation recommendations.

- Provides step-by-step workflow for regulatory assessment of any Business Associate Agreement.
- Outputs structured JSON findings for each HIPAA-required BAA provision, including compliance status, risk level, and specific recommendations.
- Includes clear assessment criteria and risk scoring rubric.
- Supplies recommended contract language for each deficiency.
- Contains detailed checklist and reference to all 9 required BAA provisions under HIPAA rules.
